description.zh: 由 DSHC 团队维护、随 DeepSeek Harness Code 发行或通过官方流程审核的插件。
description.en: Plugins maintained by the DSHC team, shipped with DeepSeek Harness Code or reviewed through the official process.

description.zh: 由社区开发者投稿的插件，经 DSHC-Hub 元数据审核后收录；源码托管在各自 GitHub 仓库。
description.en: Community-submitted plugins, indexed after DSHC-Hub metadata review; source lives in each author's GitHub repository.

description.zh: GitHub `dsh-plugin` topic 自动发现的插件目录：元数据与 README 以超链接/转发方式交付，用户本地读取；不下载、不落盘到服务器。
description.en: Auto-discovered from the GitHub `dsh-plugin` topic: metadata and README are delivered as links/forwarded reads on the user's side; nothing is downloaded or persisted on the server.

description.zh: 界面焕新：设置弹窗整体重排（导航侧栏/统一栏宽/官方令牌化卡片·输入·按钮）、全局平滑动画、模型二级菜单防抖飞出。纯注入式改造，不修改官方文件。
description.en: UI refresh: settings panel rearrangement (nav sidebar / unified column width / tokenized cards, inputs, buttons), smooth animations, debounced model submenu. Pure injection, no official file changes.

readme.zh: 通过官方格式 client bundle 注入：设置面板视觉重排 + 全局动效平滑。安装前请查看源码目录与 license。
readme.en: Injected via official-format client bundle: settings panel visual rearrangement + smooth global motion. Review the source and license before installing.

description.zh: 任意本地插件包运行时注入：工具包/守护循环/UI 面板/混合形态同一通道，注入即完整生效（host+UI）、可热重载与自重载、卸载即净。
description.en: Runtime injection for any local plugin package: toolkit / daemon-loop / UI panel / hybrid share one channel; injected = fully live (host+UI), hot-reloadable, clean uninstall.

readme.zh: 提供 dev_* 工具族：插件生产线、注入/卸载/热重载/自愈/故障演练。
readme.en: Provides the dev_* tool family: plugin pipeline, inject / uninstall / hot reload / self-heal / failure drill.

description.zh: VSCode 风格右侧边栏（explorer / editor / terminal / git / browser），按会话隔离。
description.en: VSCode-like right sidebar (explorer / editor / terminal / git / browser), isolated per conversation session.

readme.zh: DeepSeek Harness Code 官方集成插件之一，随 0.1.0-BETA3 发行。
readme.en: One of the official integrated plugins shipped with DeepSeek Harness Code 0.1.0-BETA3.

description.zh: 文本模型的视觉能力：内置免费视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（问答、定位、裁切、像素对比、长截图 OCR）。
description.en: Eyes for text-only agents: built-in free vision chain + pixel-level vision tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, long-screenshot OCR).

readme.zh: 含视觉工具集与 Vision Router 设置面板。
readme.en: Includes the vision toolchain and the Vision Router settings panel.

description.zh: 模型/推理等级二级选择：一级菜单两行固定，二级悬浮框右侧锚定行内箭头向上展开，互斥切换，双向动画。
description.en: Two-level model selection: fixed two-row primary menu, submenu anchored to the row arrow expanding upward, mutually exclusive switching, bidirectional animation.

readme.zh: DeepSeek Harness Code 官方集成插件之一。
readme.en: One of the official integrated plugins.

description.zh: 通用设置增强：重启 Harness 行、局域网访问行左右开边重构、整页 16px 节奏与右对齐归一化。
description.en: General settings enhancements: restart-harness row, LAN-access row restructure, page-wide 16px rhythm and right-alignment normalization.

readme.zh: 含重启 Harness 与局域网访问两行官方设置增强。
readme.en: Adds restart-harness and LAN-access rows to General settings.

description.zh: 品牌角标：在左侧面板品牌行 HARNESS 徽标右侧显示蓝色圆角 code 徽标（Code 整合包标识）。
description.en: Brand badge: a blue rounded 'code' badge beside the HARNESS mark (Code-pack identity). Pure UI injection.

readme.zh: 纯注入式 UI 插件，不修改任何官方文件。
readme.en: Pure injection UI plugin; no official file modified.

description.zh: 分层提示词原则注入：向 Standard 会话的系统提示追加有序行为章节。
description.en: Layered prompt-principles injection: appends ordered behavioral sections to the system prompt of Standard sessions.

readme.zh: 实验性：明确区分设计意图与提示注入副作用。
readme.en: Experimental: clearly separates design intent from prompt-injection side effects.

description.zh: 重型编码模式开关：挂载 subagent / workflow / ralph 等重型工具并注入 Coding Focus 提示；轻度模式不挂载。
description.en: Superpowers → heavy coding-mode switch: mounts subagent / workflow / ralph heavy tools with Coding Focus prompts; light mode mounts none.

readme.zh: 与 Skills 系统配合使用。

description.zh: 全局 UI 动效：平滑曲线动画、浮层入场动画、页面切换淡白过渡。不改任何 UI 位置。
description.en: Global UI motion: smooth curve animations, overlay entrance, page-switch fade. No UI position changes.

readme.zh: DeepSeek Harness Code 官方集成插件之一。
readme.en: One of the official integrated plugins.

description.zh: 官方格式桌面集成 bundle：Electron 宿主状态、设置入口与生命周期桥。
description.en: Official-format desktop integration bundle: Electron host status, settings entries and lifecycle bridge.

readme.zh: 随 DeepSeek Harness Code 发行。

description.zh: 局域网访问设置入口：在可信局域网内打开此会话的访问链接。
description.en: LAN access settings entry: open this session from another device on your trusted LAN.

readme.zh: DeepSeek Harness Code 官方集成插件之一。
readme.en: One of the official integrated plugins.

description.zh: 检查更新入口：在设置→通用最下方加一行，点击触发自动更新检查。
description.en: Update check entry: a row at the bottom of General settings that triggers the auto-update check.

readme.zh: DeepSeek Harness Code 官方集成插件之一。
readme.en: One of the official integrated plugins.

description.zh: 渐进式 Anchored Standard 代理预设：锚定会话边界与任务上下文。
description.en: Pinned progressive Anchored Standard agent preset: anchored session boundaries and task context.

readme.zh: 预设类插件：安装后在 Agent Presets 中选择。
readme.en: Preset plugin: select it under Agent Presets after install.

description.zh: 超级注入器 rc.6 slot API 阴影修复：重新注册 settings.section 'super-injector-plugins' 管理区。
description.en: Shadow-fix for the super-injector Plugins-management settings section on the rc.6 slot API.
